bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 向 $238 支撑靠近

read.en: Arm fell 4.1% on Oct 12 to $255.24, its fifth straight loss and 16% below the Oct 5 close. It is below its 5, 10, 30 ($276) and 100-day ($297) averages, holding only above the 200-day ($221). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28, and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Arm 10月12日下跌 4.1%，收于 $255.24，连跌五日，较 10月5日收盘价下跌 16%。股价位于 5 日、10 日、30 日（$276）和 100 日（$297）均线下方，仅守在 200 日均线（$221）之上。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方且柱体扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空，RSI 为 41。

read.en: The next test is $238, which has held five times since July. Below it, $221–225 (200-day average and Sep 3 low) is the last major support before $201. A bounce would first meet the 30-day average and Oct 8 breakdown level at $276, then the 100-day near $298; the medium-term range runs $238–337.
read.zh: 下一测试位为 $238，该位置自 7月以来五次守住。若跌破，$221–225（200 日均线及 9月3日低点）是 $201 之前最后的重要支撑。若反弹，首先遇到 $276 的 30 日均线及 10月8日破位处，其次约 $298 的 100 日均线；中期区间为 $238–337。

r.en: Sep 23 swing high, top of the range
